name: Athens
title: Holidays in Athens
intro: The Acropolis above a buzzing modern city, with ancient sites, rooftop bars and islands an hour away. Here's what Athens is like, when to go and how long to stay.
image_alt: The Acropolis rising on its rocky hill above the white buildings of Athens
facts_note: The EU is bringing in new entry checks, so check the rules on GOV.UK before you book.
when_to_go: April, May and October are the best months, warm and sunny for walking between sites. June and September are hot but good. July and August are very hot, often over 33°C, and heatwaves can close the Acropolis in the afternoon. Winter is mild with short queues, though it can rain.

things.name: Acropolis and Parthenon
things.blurb: Book a timed slot and go at opening or late in the day to avoid the heat and crowds.

things.name: Acropolis Museum
things.blurb: Statues from the Parthenon in a light-filled museum, with ruins under the glass floor.

things.name: Plaka and Anafiotika
things.blurb: Old lanes under the Acropolis, with tavernas and a tiny village of island-style houses.

things.name: Ancient Agora
things.blurb: The ancient marketplace, with the well-preserved Temple of Hephaestus.

things.name: Lycabettus Hill
things.blurb: Walk or take the funicular to the city's highest point for sunset views.

things.name: Cape Sounion
things.blurb: The clifftop Temple of Poseidon, a short drive along the coast, best at sunset.

faqs.question: How many days do you need in Athens?
faqs.answer: Two to three days covers the main sites. Add a day for Sounion, Delphi or an island like Aegina.

faqs.question: Is Athens too hot in summer?
faqs.answer: July and August are very hot. Visit sites early, rest in the afternoon and check for closures during heatwaves.

faqs.question: Can you combine Athens with an island?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ferries from Piraeus reach Aegina in about an hour and the Cyclades in a few hours.

faqs.question: Is there a combined ticket for Athens' sites?
faqs.answer: Yes, a combined ticket covers the Acropolis and several other sites. Check the latest price and rules on the official site.
